scripts.build: node log.js build & node ./node_modules/vite/bin/vite.js build --config vite/config.prod.mjs && node tools/prune-production-assets.mjs
scripts.build-nolog: npm run prepare:maps && node ./node_modules/vite/bin/vite.js build --config vite/config.prod.mjs && node tools/prune-production-assets.mjs
scripts.android:sync: npm run build-nolog && npx cap sync android
scripts.android:build:debug: npm run android:sync && cd android && JAVA_HOME="$(/usr/libexec/java_home -v 21)" ./gradlew clean assembleDebug
scripts.android:build:release: npm run android:sync && cd android && JAVA_HOME="$(/usr/libexec/java_home -v 21)" ./gradlew clean bundleRelease
scripts.android:build:device-release: npm run android:sync && cd android && JAVA_HOME="$(/usr/libexec/java_home -v 21)" ./gradlew clean assembleDeviceRelease
scripts.android:perf:debug:diagnostic: PATH="$(pwd)/.venv/bin:$PATH" CAPACITOR_PERF_TEST=1 CAPACITOR_PERF_PROFILE=diagnostic CAPACITOR_WEB_DEBUG=1 VITE_ANDROID_PERF=1 VITE_ANDROID_PERF_PROFILE=diagnostic VITE_ANDROID_DIAGNOSTICS=1 npm run build-nolog && CAPACITOR_PERF_TEST=1 CAPACITOR_PERF_PROFILE=diagnostic CAPACITOR_WEB_DEBUG=1 npx cap sync android && cd android && JAVA_HOME="$(/usr/libexec/java_home -v 21)" ./gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.android:perf:debug: PATH="$(pwd)/.venv/bin:$PATH" CAPACITOR_PERF_TEST=1 CAPACITOR_PERF_PROFILE=telemetry CAPACITOR_WEB_DEBUG=1 VITE_ANDROID_PERF=1 VITE_ANDROID_PERF_PROFILE=telemetry npm run build-nolog && CAPACITOR_PERF_TEST=1 CAPACITOR_PERF_PROFILE=telemetry CAPACITOR_WEB_DEBUG=1 npx cap sync android && cd android && JAVA_HOME="$(/usr/libexec/java_home -v 21)" ./gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.android:perf:release: PATH="$(pwd)/.venv/bin:$PATH" CAPACITOR_PERF_TEST=1 CAPACITOR_PERF_PROFILE=telemetry VITE_ANDROID_PERF=1 VITE_ANDROID_PERF_PROFILE=telemetry npm run build-nolog && CAPACITOR_PERF_TEST=1 CAPACITOR_PERF_PROFILE=telemetry CAPACITOR_PERF_MOBILE_TEXTURES=0 npx cap sync android && cd android && JAVA_HOME="$(/usr/libexec/java_home -v 21)" ./gradlew assembleBenchmark
scripts.tiled:check: npm run tiled:trees:check && npm run tiled:build && npm run tiled:validate
scripts.prepare:maps: python3 tools/build-reference-map-tiles.py && python3 tools/build-navigation-marker-tiles.py && npm run tiled:nav:standardize && npm run campaign:economy && npm run tiled:trees:normalize && npm run tiled:build && npm run assets:map-atlases
